description: Plays a sound when Caps Lock, Num Lock, or Scroll Lock is turned on or off. Choose from eight built-in sounds or your own WAV file, independently for each key and each on/off state, with per-key volume control.
changelog:
# 1.1.1

* Confirmed compatibility with NVDA 2026.3

# 1.1.0

* Per-key volume control for Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll Lock

# 1.0.0

Initial release. Sound feedback for Caps Lock, Num Lock, and Scroll
Lock, with independent on/off sound selection per key from an
eight-sound pack or your own custom WAV files.
